onboardingLanguageHint.en: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboardingLanguageHint.fr: Vous pourrez la changer à tout moment dans les Réglages.
onboardingLanguageHint.it: Puoi cambiarla in qualsiasi momento nelle Impostazioni.
onboardingLanguageHint.ro: O poți schimba oricând din Setări.
onboardingLanguageHint.sw: Unaweza kuibadilisha wakati wowote kwenye Mipangilio.
onboardingLanguageHint.tl: Mababago mo ito anumang oras sa Settings.
onboardingLanguageHint.es: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboardingLanguageHint.pt: You can change this any time in Settings.

onboardingBibleBody.en: Pick the translation you read most. You can show a second one side by side.
onboardingBibleBody.fr: Choisissez la traduction que vous lisez le plus. Vous pouvez en afficher une seconde en parallèle.
onboardingBibleBody.it: Scegli la traduzione che leggi di più. Puoi affiancarne una seconda.
onboardingBibleBody.ro: Alege traducerea pe care o citești cel mai des. Poți afișa și una a doua alături.
onboardingBibleBody.sw: Chagua tafsiri unayosoma zaidi. Unaweza kuonyesha nyingine ya pili kando yake.
onboardingBibleBody.tl: Piliin ang saling madalas mong basahin. Maaari kang magpakita ng pangalawa nang magkatabi.
onboardingBibleBody.es: Pick the translation you read most. You can show a second one side by side.
onboardingBibleBody.pt: Pick the translation you read most. You can show a second one side by side.

onboardingSecondaryDesc.en: Shown alongside your main Bible in parallel view
onboardingSecondaryDesc.fr: Affichée à côté de votre Bible principale en vue parallèle
onboardingSecondaryDesc.it: Mostrata a fianco della tua Bibbia principale nella vista parallela
onboardingSecondaryDesc.ro: Afișată alături de Biblia principală în vizualizarea paralelă
onboardingSecondaryDesc.sw: Inaonyeshwa kando ya Biblia yako kuu katika mwonekano sambamba
onboardingSecondaryDesc.tl: Ipinapakita sa tabi ng iyong Bibliya sa parallel view
onboardingSecondaryDesc.es: Shown alongside your main Bible in parallel view
onboardingSecondaryDesc.pt: Shown alongside your main Bible in parallel view

onboardingLookBody.en: Choose a page color, font and text size. Everything can be fine-tuned later.
onboardingLookBody.fr: Choisissez une couleur de page, une police et une taille de texte. Tout reste ajustable ensuite.
onboardingLookBody.it: Scegli il colore della pagina, il carattere e la dimensione del testo. Potrai regolare tutto in seguito.
onboardingLookBody.ro: Alege culoarea paginii, fontul și mărimea textului. Totul se poate ajusta ulterior.
onboardingLookBody.sw: Chagua rangi ya ukurasa, mtindo wa maandishi na ukubwa. Kila kitu kinaweza kurekebishwa baadaye.
onboardingLookBody.tl: Pumili ng kulay ng pahina, font at laki ng teksto. Maaaring ayusin ang lahat mamaya.
onboardingLookBody.es: Choose a page color, font and text size. Everything can be fine-tuned later.
onboardingLookBody.pt: Choose a page color, font and text size. Everything can be fine-tuned later.

onboardingThemeDailyDesc.en: Changes daily to reflect the rich themes of Scripture
onboardingThemeDailyDesc.fr: Change chaque jour pour refléter les riches thèmes des Écritures
onboardingThemeDailyDesc.it: Cambia ogni giorno per riflettere i ricchi temi delle Scritture
onboardingThemeDailyDesc.ro: Se schimbă zilnic pentru a reflecta temele bogate ale Scripturii
onboardingThemeDailyDesc.sw: Hubadilika kila siku kuakisi mandhari tele ya Maandiko
onboardingThemeDailyDesc.tl: Nagbabago araw-araw upang ipakita ang mayayamang tema ng Kasulatan
onboardingThemeDailyDesc.es: Changes daily to reflect the rich themes of Scripture
onboardingThemeDailyDesc.pt: Changes daily to reflect the rich themes of Scripture

onboardingPreviewVerse.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
onboardingPreviewVerse.fr: Au commencement était la Parole, et la Parole était avec Dieu, et la Parole était Dieu.
onboardingPreviewVerse.it: Nel principio era la Parola, e la Parola era presso Dio, e la Parola era Dio.
onboardingPreviewVerse.ro: La început era Cuvântul, și Cuvântul era cu Dumnezeu, și Cuvântul era Dumnezeu.
onboardingPreviewVerse.sw: Hapo mwanzo kulikuwako Neno, naye Neno alikuwako kwa Mungu, naye Neno alikuwa Mungu.
onboardingPreviewVerse.tl: Nang pasimula ay ang Salita, at ang Salita ay kasama ng Diyos, at ang Salita ay Diyos.
onboardingPreviewVerse.es: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
onboardingPreviewVerse.pt: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

onboardingFeaturesTitle.it: Tutto per il tuo cammino quotidiano
onboardingFeaturesTitle.ro: Tot ce-ți trebuie zi de zi
onboardingFeaturesTitle.sw: Kila kitu kwa safari yako ya kila siku
onboardingFeaturesTitle.tl: Lahat para sa iyong araw-araw na paglakad

onboardingFeatureWordBody.en: Read without distraction, with highlights, notes and bookmarks.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.fr: Lisez sans distraction, avec surlignages, notes et signets.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.it: Leggi senza distrazioni, con evidenziazioni, note e segnalibri.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.ro: Citește fără distrageri, cu evidențieri, notițe și semne de carte.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.sw: Soma bila usumbufu, ukiwa na alama, maelezo na vialamisho.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.tl: Magbasa nang walang abala, may highlight, tala at bookmark.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.es: Read without distraction, with highlights, notes and bookmarks.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.pt: Read without distraction, with highlights, notes and bookmarks.

onboardingFeaturePlansBody.en: Chronological, thematic or your own — with gentle reminders.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.fr: Chronologiques, thématiques ou personnels — avec de doux rappels.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.it: Cronologici, tematici o personali — con promemoria discreti.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.ro: Cronologice, tematice sau proprii — cu mementouri discrete.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.sw: Ya mpangilio wa wakati, ya mada au yako mwenyewe — pamoja na vikumbusho vya upole.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.tl: Kronolohikal, ayon sa paksa o sarili mo — may banayad na paalala.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.es: Chronological, thematic or your own — with gentle reminders.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.pt: Chronological, thematic or your own — with gentle reminders.

onboardingFeatureStudyBody.en: Commentary, dictionary, Strong's and maps, right beside the text.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.fr: Commentaires, dictionnaire, Strong et cartes, juste à côté du texte.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.it: Commentari, dizionario, Strong e mappe, accanto al testo.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.ro: Comentarii, dicționar, Strong și hărți, chiar lângă text.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.sw: Maelezo, kamusi, Strong na ramani, kando ya maandiko.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.tl: Komentaryo, diksyunaryo, Strong at mapa, katabi ng teksto.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.es: Commentary, dictionary, Strong's and maps, right beside the text.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.pt: Commentary, dictionary, Strong's and maps, right beside the text.

onboardingFeatureSyncBody.en: Sign in any time to sync across your devices. No account needed to read.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.fr: Connectez-vous quand vous voulez pour synchroniser vos appareils. Aucun compte n'est requis pour lire.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.it: Accedi quando vuoi per sincronizzare i tuoi dispositivi. Per leggere non serve un account.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.ro: Conectează-te oricând pentru a sincroniza dispozitivele. Pentru citit nu ai nevoie de cont.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.sw: Ingia wakati wowote ili kusawazisha vifaa vyako. Huhitaji akaunti ili kusoma.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.tl: Mag-sign in anumang oras para i-sync ang iyong mga device. Hindi kailangan ng account para magbasa.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.es: Sign in any time to sync across your devices. No account needed to read.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.pt: Sign in any time to sync across your devices. No account needed to read.

onboardingReminderBody.en: A short nudge at the time you choose helps build a daily habit. We only notify you for reading — never ads.
onboardingReminderBody.fr: Un petit rappel à l'heure choisie aide à prendre une habitude quotidienne. Uniquement pour la lecture — jamais de publicité.
onboardingReminderBody.it: Un piccolo promemoria all'ora che scegli aiuta a creare un'abitudine quotidiana. Solo per la lettura — mai pubblicità.
onboardingReminderBody.ro: Un mic memento la ora aleasă te ajută să-ți formezi un obicei zilnic. Doar pentru citire — niciodată reclame.
onboardingReminderBody.sw: Ukumbusho mfupi kwa wakati unaouchagua husaidia kujenga desturi ya kila siku. Ni kwa kusoma tu — kamwe si matangazo.
onboardingReminderBody.tl: Ang maikling paalala sa oras na pipiliin mo ay tumutulong bumuo ng araw-araw na gawi. Para lang sa pagbasa — hindi kailanman ad.
onboardingReminderBody.es: A short nudge at the time you choose helps build a daily habit. We only notify you for reading — never ads.
onboardingReminderBody.pt: A short nudge at the time you choose helps build a daily habit. We only notify you for reading — never ads.

onboardingReminderToggle.en: Remind me to read each day
onboardingReminderToggle.fr: Me rappeler de lire chaque jour
onboardingReminderToggle.es: Remind me to read each day
onboardingReminderToggle.pt: Remind me to read each day

onboardingReminderPermission.en: Your phone will ask permission to show notifications. You can change this later in Settings.
onboardingReminderPermission.fr: Votre téléphone demandera l'autorisation d'afficher des notifications. Modifiable plus tard dans les Réglages.
onboardingReminderPermission.it: Il telefono chiederà il permesso di mostrare notifiche. Potrai cambiarlo nelle Impostazioni.
onboardingReminderPermission.ro: Telefonul va cere permisiunea de a afișa notificări. O poți schimba ulterior din Setări.
onboardingReminderPermission.sw: Simu yako itaomba ruhusa ya kuonyesha arifa. Unaweza kubadilisha hili baadaye kwenye Mipangilio.
onboardingReminderPermission.tl: Hihingi ng pahintulot ang iyong telepono na magpakita ng notification. Mababago ito mamaya sa Settings.
onboardingReminderPermission.es: Your phone will ask permission to show notifications. You can change this later in Settings.
onboardingReminderPermission.pt: Your phone will ask permission to show notifications. You can change this later in Settings.

onboardingAccountTitle.it: Tieni al sicuro le tue note
onboardingAccountTitle.tl: Panatilihing ligtas ang iyong mga tala

onboardingAccountBody.en: Signing in is optional. The app works fully offline without an account. With one, your highlights, notes, bookmarks and plans are backed up and kept in step across your devices.
onboardingAccountBody.fr: La connexion est facultative. L'application fonctionne entièrement hors ligne sans compte. Avec un compte, vos surlignages, notes, signets et plans sont sauvegardés et synchronisés entre vos appareils.
onboardingAccountBody.it: L'accesso è facoltativo. L'app funziona completamente offline senza account. Con un account, evidenziazioni, note, segnalibri e piani vengono salvati e sincronizzati tra i tuoi dispositivi.
onboardingAccountBody.ro: Conectarea este opțională. Aplicația funcționează complet offline, fără cont. Cu un cont, evidențierile, notițele, semnele de carte și planurile sunt salvate și sincronizate pe dispozitivele tale.
onboardingAccountBody.sw: Kuingia ni hiari. Programu hufanya kazi kikamilifu bila mtandao na bila akaunti. Ukiwa na akaunti, alama, maelezo, vialamisho na mipango yako huhifadhiwa na kusawazishwa kwenye vifaa vyako.
onboardingAccountBody.tl: Opsyonal ang pag-sign in. Gumagana nang buo ang app offline kahit walang account. Kapag may account, naka-back up at naka-sync sa iyong mga device ang iyong mga highlight, tala, bookmark at plano.
onboardingAccountBody.es: Signing in is optional. The app works fully offline without an account. With one, your highlights, notes, bookmarks and plans are backed up and kept in step across your devices.
onboardingAccountBody.pt: Signing in is optional. The app works fully offline without an account. With one, your highlights, notes, bookmarks and plans are backed up and kept in step across your devices.
